original_target.title: The sharp radius in quantitative Steinitz selection

scope_comparison: The 2024 theorem gives radius1/(6d^2) and retains the sharp c/sqrt(d) conjecture. The September2026 colourful theorem has a much smaller radius and translated centers. OpenAI097 is a signing/rearrangement prefix-sum bound, not selection of <=2d points retaining a ball about the fixed origin.
